$comment: DRAFT for developer review. Name: VeloPair (gate #1 closed 2026-08-17); attorney trademark clearance still pending. Cross-references to industry catalogues (BIDEX, FIT, schema.org) live in docs/MAPPINGS.md, not in this file.
title: Bike
description: A bicycle, described at three separable levels: product identity (which model), instance identity (which physical bike), and physical properties (geometry, wheels, drivetrain). All values are metric; units are part of the field name.

spec_version.description: Version of this specification the document conforms to.

profile_id.description: Opaque stable identifier chosen by the producing application (a UUID is recommended).

identity.description: Product-level identity, following industry convergence (BIDEX, Veloconnect, Google Merchant): GTIN where the manufacturer assigned one, else brand plus MPN, else the brand + model + year (+ size + color) composite. Never fabricate a GTIN.

year.description: Model year. Carryover models can keep one GTIN across years, so year is identity, not decoration.

size.description: Manufacturer size label as printed ('56', 'M', 'L56'). Not a measurement; measurements live in geometry.

variant.description: Manufacturer variant discriminator beyond size and color (build kit, motor option).

gtin.description: GS1 GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits) of this exact variant, if the manufacturer assigned one.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number of this exact variant. Meaningful only together with brand.

instance.description: This physical bike, as opposed to the product. Sensitive: frame numbers identify property. Producers must only export this block on explicit rider action.

frame_number.description: Frame serial as engraved, opaque. No format standard exists (registries fuzzy-match O/0, S/5, L/1); do not validate, do not normalize.

odometer_km.description: Total distance this physical bike has been ridden.

geometry.description: Frame and cockpit geometry of this size. All fields optional because real-world data is partial; consumers must tolerate any subset.

stack_mm.description: Vertical distance from bottom bracket center to the top of the head tube.

reach_mm.description: Horizontal distance from bottom bracket center to the top of the head tube.

seat_tube_length_mm.description: Bottom bracket center to the top of the seat tube, along the tube.

seat_tube_angle_deg.description: Effective seat tube angle from horizontal.

stem_angle_deg.description: Stem angle relative to the steerer axis.

spacer_height_mm.description: Total spacer stack under the stem as specced.

wheelbase_mm.description: Distance between front and rear axles.

standover_mm.description: Standover height above ground at the top tube.

chainstay_length_mm.description: Bottom bracket center to rear axle.

fork_rake_mm.description: Fork offset from the steering axis.

fork_length_mm.description: Fork installation length, axle to crown.

bottom_bracket_height_mm.description: Bottom bracket center height above ground.

bottom_bracket_drop_mm.description: Bottom bracket center depth below the axle line.

wheel_diameter_etrto_mm.description: ETRTO rim diameter (622 for 700c/29er, 584 for 650b/27.5, 559 for 26in).

cassette_speed_count.description: Rear speeds; with chainring_count gives the '2x12' style designation.

chainring_teeth.description: Largest first. Also present in FIT bike_profile.front_gear.

cassette_teeth.description: Smallest first. Also present in FIT bike_profile.rear_gear.

weight_kg.description: Complete bike weight as specced for this size.

ebike.description: Present only when motor_assistance is not 'none'.

claimed_range_km.description: Manufacturer-claimed range; measured behaviour belongs to consumers, not this object.

extensions.description: Producer-specific data under reverse-domain keys. Consumers must ignore unknown extensions.
